cache_policy: No eviction; transfer/hashverification warmsOScache. Reopen pergroup is handle-first only.
percentile: Nearest-rank per-trial20 and pooled40 per profile/mode/scope. Retain first/warmup separately.
failure_policy: Singleattempt600s trial, retain perquery started/completed and malformedtail; stopfuturetrials onfailure; no restart solely onpolltimeout.
io_policy: GNU time file-system input/output counters asobservedcounts; physicalIO bytesunknown, no block-to-physicalbyte claim
extra_stdout_scope: query_started before timed execute; diagnostic logging enters whole-worker GNU time counters.
scope: Linux x86_64 native exactRust1.80.0, fixed synthetic100k/768d calibration; not complete update/delete/crash lifecycle or independent quality
